title: Storage Rental in the Household: Stand-Alone Pricing, the Parking Bundle and the Oversized Suite Floor-Plan Gate
content:
A Storage Rental is priced on its own, but an active Storage Rental on a lease earns the lease's covered and garage Parking Licenses the bundle discount set in the Parking License terms; ending or overlocking the last active Storage Rental ends that discount from the next parking fee charge day. The Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) is available only to a lease whose floor plan has at least two bedrooms.

## The rule taken apart

| Element | What it says |
|---|---|
| Storage pricing | Every Storage Rental is priced on its own; holding parking does not change storage rent. |
| What earns the bundle discount | An active Storage Rental on the lease. |
| Which parking is discounted | The lease's covered and garage Parking Licenses. |
| Size of the discount | As set in the Parking License terms, not in the Storage Rental terms. |
| When the discount stops | When the last active Storage Rental on the lease ends or is overlocked; the discount ends from the next parking fee charge day. |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | Available only to a lease whose floor plan has at least two bedrooms. |

## Questions this rule answers

**Does a resident with a covered or garage parking space pay less storage rent?** No. A Storage Rental is priced on its own; the bundle works in the other direction, on the parking side.

**A lease has two active Storage Rentals and one of them ends. Does the parking bundle discount stop?** No. The discount ends when the *last* active Storage Rental ends or is overlocked; with the other rental still active, the lease still holds an active Storage Rental.

**A lease's only active Storage Rental is overlocked. What happens to the bundle discount?** Overlocking the last active Storage Rental ends the discount, from the next parking fee charge day.

**From when does the discount end?** From the next parking fee charge day after the last active Storage Rental ends or is overlocked, not retroactively.

**Which leases may rent the Oversized Storage Suite (10x10)?** Only a lease whose floor plan has at least two bedrooms. A floor plan with fewer than two bedrooms does not meet this condition, whatever else the lease holds.

## Hypothetical cases

| Lease (hypothetical) | Storage Rentals | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| Lease A, two-bedroom floor plan | Asks for an Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | Floor-plan condition met |
| Lease B, one-bedroom floor plan | Asks for an Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | Floor-plan condition not met; the suite is not available to this lease |
| Lease C, holds a structured garage parking space | One active Storage Rental | The garage Parking License earns the bundle discount |
| Lease C, later | That single Storage Rental ends | The bundle discount ends from the next parking fee charge day |
